/scripts.value:
on PrepareQuizForStudyGuide
	// HERE WE DELETE UNNEEEDED KEYS
	repeat for each key xThisQuestion in StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"]
		delete variable StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"][xThisQuestion]["cdb"]
		delete variable StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"][xThisQuestion]["createdBy"]
		delete variable StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"][xThisQuestion]["quizID"]
		delete variable StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"][xThisQuestion]["QuestionID"]
	end repeat
	
	if StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"] is not empty and StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Info"] is not empty then
		put "ready" into StudyGuideQuizPayload 	
	else if StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Questions"] is empty and StudyGuideQuizArray["Quiz"]["Info"] is not empty then
		put "no questions" into StudyGuideQuizPayload
	else
		put "no description" into StudyGuideQuizPayload
	end if
end PrepareQuizForStudyGuide
